payload.register:
R1 (functional) DEFAULT PROVISION - When se_loop_start opens an iteration, the engine shall provision iter/<iteration> in .worktrees/<iteration> and open the instance there. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: iterations run on trunk (the opt-in defect returns). source: UC-1, note-e8a12b600638.

R2 (constraint) NEVER NEST - The engine shall not provision a worktree when the root is already a worktree (a worktree-resident loop starts plain). verify: test. breaks_if_removed: infinite worktree nesting. source: UC-1 ext, loop.ts isWorktreeRoot.

R3 (functional) LIVE ROUTING - While an iteration's instance lives in a worktree, when se_loop_next/submit/gate/ship is called on the trunk-rooted server, the engine shall locate and drive that worktree-resident instance. verify: demonstration (live end-to-end). breaks_if_removed: the server cannot continue a branched iteration (the untested defect). source: UC-1 step 5/5a, note-6815f9db4930.

R4 (functional) LOCAL TOP-LEVEL MACHINE - When an iteration provides a local top-level machine (seeded from systematic, trimmed), the engine shall run the iteration on that machine instead of the shared systematic. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: no per-iteration trim; the refine cut has no home. source: UC-2.

R5 (constraint) TRIMMED-MACHINE INTEGRITY - The engine shall refuse a local machine that does not compile or validate (e.g. a removed state leaving a dangling edge), naming the offending element. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a broken trimmed machine wedges the walk. source: UC-2 ext 3a, compile.ts/validateMachine.

R6 (functional) HONEST MERGE (i5, re-affirmed live) - When a second iteration ships touching a ledger node the first also changed, the engine shall mark that node suspect. verify: test (i5's, re-run live). breaks_if_removed: silent merge. source: UC-3.

R7 (quality) PROVEN-LIVE ACCEPTANCE - The live end-to-end path (open -> walk -> gate -> ship in a worktree) shall be proven by a demonstration test through the real tool surface; unit-green shall not satisfy acceptance. six-part: stimulus = run the acceptance test; response = an iteration completes IN its worktree via real tools; measure = passes through the real surface, not a hand-rooted loop. verify: demonstration. breaks_if_removed: the untested-live regression recurs. source: process-stale finding, R3.

R8 (interface/guidance) INHERIT GUIDANCE - The framing-state guidance (draft_vision/define_actual/frame_delta) shall instruct inheriting se.vision (pointer + delta) unless the iteration deviates. verify: inspection. breaks_if_removed: agents re-derive vision needlessly. source: owner feedback this session, the state-inheritance ruling.
payload.set_criteria: Complete: R1-R6 cover all three use cases, R7 binds the acceptance, R8 the owner's guidance fix. Consistent: no conflicts; R2 bounds R1, R5 bounds R4, R7 governs how R1-R6 are accepted. Affordable: mostly WIRING over existing i5 primitives (provision/merge/suspect) and the machine compiler - the only genuinely-new build is spanning openInstance (R3) and lifting the local machine to top-level (R4). Bounded: excludes the general strike-list, auto-skip judgment, the two-at-once demo, and i9 board work (all in non-goals).
